title: QuickCart — Your Price, As Submitted
objective: Checkout trusts whatever price your browser sends it. Buy the featured item for a lot less than its real price.

verifier.condition: An order for the featured item is placed at a unit price lower than the catalog's real price for it.

weakness: The checkout step takes the unit price directly from the request instead of looking it up server-side from the product catalog, so the submitted price is whatever the client sends.
seededData: One featured product, a $1,200 standing desk, in a fixed catalog. In-memory order log.
hints: Check out normally first and look at exactly which fields the checkout form actually sends.
The real price lives in the product catalog. Does checkout look it up there, or does it just believe what it's told?
A hidden form field is still just a value your browser sends — nothing stops you from sending a different one.
burpNotes: Send the checkout request to Repeater and change unitPriceUsd directly — no need to touch the quantity.
